column3: The compaction threshold is an owner percentage of each model's window, applied as pi compaction.modelOverrides through a live settings getter (ctx.pi.compaction, src/kernel/pi.ts); conv.context.compactAt uses the same formula
column4: pi 1.5 resolves compaction per model (exact provider/modelId), never per conversation, and reads settings at every use, so a getter makes the owner setting live without a restart; a fraction suits 32k and 1M windows alike where a fixed token count does not
column5: plugins/models/models.test.ts: 80% on a 128k model gives compactAt 102400 and reserveTokens 25600; clearing restores pi defaults
